OBJECT Codeunit 50001 Unused Local Var
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=BEGIN
            // CAL001: UnusedTrigVarL must be removed along with empty VAR section
            RunCheck();
          END;
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE RunCheck@1();
    VAR
      UsedVarL@1000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // CAL001: UnusedVarL and UnusedLocalTxt are unused and must be removed
      UsedVarL := 42;
      MESSAGE('%1', UsedVarL);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      Documentation block stays untouched.
    }
    END.
  }
}
